about.intro: Between university and projects, I'm discovering how to turn what I study into software.
about.name: Daniel Tsuruga
about.photoAlt: Illustration of Daniel at his workspace, with references to programming, music and Galo

sections.label: Who I am
sections.texto: I'm Daniel, a Software Engineering student at PUC Minas, in Belo Horizonte. I'm building my path in programming, trying to understand not only how things work, but also why they work. I enjoy learning by doing and watching my ideas take shape.

sections.label: What I do
sections.texto: I like to learn by building. Through exercises, studies and personal projects, I've been exploring different technologies and discovering new ways to solve problems. More than just making something work, I like to understand what lies behind it and find ways to do it better.

sections.label: Beyond the code
sections.texto: Outside of programming, I'm a great admirer of music, I enjoy football, I support Galo (Atlético-MG) and I have a special interest in philosophy. I like to question things, learn other perspectives and better understand the world around me. I think that curiosity also shows in the way I learn and develop my projects.

experiences.descricao: I lead the team developing MeuBolso, a personal finance control and education application. I work on project management, quality control and documentation, coordinating the team and tracking deliverables.

I took part in developing EcoFlux, a recycling and selective waste collection platform. I contributed to problem research, the stakeholder map and solution brainstorming, applying Design Thinking and collaborative work with Git.
